To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the best way to evolve an approach to address a new concern is to use a new approach to cover the new concern, but that this approach must be compatible with the original approach, so it can be used as an extension of the original approach.

(a) extending a method with a new concern may be the simplest alternative but it is also the most risky, (b) the merger of two approaches is an interesting alternative, but it is also risky and error-pron, since it requires the adaptation of both approaches and (c) the use of an interoperable and architecture-centric approach is the safest option, since it does not require the modification of the original approaches and the new concern can be added without modifying any of the original approaches.

(1) the addition of a concern is a complex process that requires the adaptation of all the method’s artifacts and (2) the architectural-centric approach is a good alternative that can be used in a wide range of scenarios.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of different strategies to address the addition of new concerns in a Model-Drive Web Engineering approach.
the evolution of Model-Driven Web engineering approaches in order to address new concerns.
the evolution of Web Engineering approaches and, in particular, with the incorporation of new concerns in Model-Driven approaches.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best alternative depends on the specific context.
the best approach to address a new concern is to use an architectural-centric method.
the architectural-centric approach is the most suitable one to deal with the addition of a concern in a model-driven Web Engineering approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the evolution of a Model-Driven approach is a complex process and that there is no silver bullet.
we are not proposing a new approach, but a way to evolve an existing approach in order to incorporate a new concern, which is a common problem in any approach.
the addition of a concern in an existing method can be done in different ways and each one has its pros and cons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the evolution of a method is not an easy task.
the evolution of Model-Driven Web engineering approaches is not a trivial process and it should be done carefully in order to avoid the loss of the main characteristics of the original proposal.
the architectural approach is a viable option to address new concerns in model-driven approaches.
